name: Kwan Consulting
description: Corporate one-page site for an Accra business consulting firm serving entrepreneurs, SMEs, Ghanaians abroad and foreign investors: an inset full-bleed hero with three rotating headlines and tabs, lime pill buttons with arrow circles, a who-we-are trio, eight photo service cards that open a detail modal (what is included, who it is for, timeline and starting price), a Ghana Launch Package with a promo card, a royal-blue approach band with glass cards, a photo banner, a testimonial beside a lime starter-guide card, a centred FAQ, a consultation form and a royal-blue footer. Layout inspired by lumincoreconsult.com; brand, copy, photos and code are original.
